title: Reschedule Meetings for Maximum Free Time I
summary: Given an event duration and non-overlapping meeting times, reschedule at most k meetings by adjusting their start times to maximize the longest continuous free time within the event.
statement: Given an event duration and non-overlapping meeting times, reschedule at most k meetings by adjusting their start times to maximize the longest continuous free time within the event. Maintain the meetings' order and ensure they remain non-overlapping. The meetings cannot be rescheduled to times outside the event.
constraints: Meetings are positive-duration, sorted, non-overlapping, and contained in 0..event_time.
Move at most k meetings without changing durations or meeting order.
Return the longest continuous free interval possible.
hints: Moving k consecutive meetings together can merge the k+1 free gaps around and between them.
Compute all free gaps and find the largest sum of k+1 consecutive gaps.
Build boundary and interior gaps, then slide a fixed window of length k+1.
Any order-preserving move affects a consecutive meeting block, and its total surrounding free space is both an upper bound and achievable.
editorial: Any order-preserving move affects a consecutive meeting block, and its total surrounding free space is both an upper bound and achievable.

tests.explanation: Moving the first meeting next to the second combines the two surrounding one-unit gaps into two free units.
Moving both meetings together consolidates all eight free time units into one interval.
